parse.title: Martial Demon
parse.text:
Overview

Martial Demon is a Legendary unit. He is only obtainable through completing Infinity Train with a small chance, or by buying him at the Raid Shop for 50 Blazing Shards.

Evolving

Martial Demon can evolve into Martial Demon (Destruction) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
